core: Growth hormone axis signaling and somatic growth
qualifier: including GPCR control of GH secretion
name: Growth hormone axis: receptor signaling and secretory control
rationale: Members concern GH receptor/JAK-STAT signaling, IGF and body-growth regulation and leptin, and unlike the cytokine/prolactin/thyroid confusables they include the GPCR/adenylate cyclase arm (somatostatin, glucagon-family GHRH receptors) that controls GH secretion.

name: Left-right asymmetry and planar polarity in embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover planar cell polarity/convergent extension and Nodal/SMO-dependent left-right axis determination; the left-right asymmetry members are what the Wnt/PCP and hedgehog/neural plate confusables lack.

name: Transcriptional repression through modulation of DNA binding
rationale: Members concern negative control of transcription initiation and of transcription-factor DNA binding (with TGFBR3 expression as a repressed target), whereas confusables are specific gene-transcription programs (CDH1, RUNX3, FOXO) or BMP/cell-cycle contexts.

name: Glycerolipid metabolism: phospholipid remodeling and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members span glycerophospholipid synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling together with DAG/TAG turnover, lipid droplets and adipocyte lipolysis, which separates it from the TG-only, glycerol/fructose and sphingolipid confusables.

name: UV lesion recognition and incision in global-genome excision repair
rationale: All members concern UV-induced pyrimidine dimer repair by GG-NER damage recognition and dual incision, distinguishing it from transcription-coupled NER and from gap-filling/translesion synthesis confusables.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT in atrioventricular valve formation
rationale: All members concern endocardial cushion EMT and fusion forming the mitral/tricuspid (atrioventricular) valves, whereas confusables cover myocardium/septum, outflow tract/semilunar valves or early heart tube.

core: Innate sensing of bacterial cell-wall lipids
name: TLR2/TLR4 sensing of bacterial lipopolysaccharide and lipopeptides
rationale: Members concern detection of LPS (LBP-CD14 transfer), diacyl lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid via TLR4/TLR2, which separates it from NOD/peptidoglycan sensing and broader monocyte inflammatory confusables.

qualifier: Aurora A and PLK1 regulation at mitotic entry
name: Centrosome maturation and Aurora A control at mitotic entry
rationale: Members concern recruitment of centrosome proteins (NuMA, Nlp loss) and AURKA/PLK1 regulation at G2/M; the AURKA regulators (TPX2, FBXL7, PHLDA1) distinguish it from spindle orientation, centriole duplication and microtubule nucleation confusables.

name: Neuronal migration and cortical lamination in brain development
rationale: Members concern radial and tangential neuron migration, cortical layering and regionalization and forebrain axon tracts, distinguishing it from cerebellar, neural-tube patterning, neuroblast-division and reelin confusables.

qualifier: phosphatase inactivation of ERK, JNK and p38
name: Phosphatase-mediated inactivation of ERK, JNK and p38 MAPKs
rationale: Members concern feedback suppression of MAPKs by threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation across ERK, JNK and p38, unlike the ERK-only, IL-6 and JNK-activating confusables.

qualifier: definitive endoderm and early gut morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation, definitive endoderm formation and early gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, EMT and germ layer formation, endoderm specification and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis with pluripotency factors, distinguishing it from cardiac mesoderm and pancreatic lineage confusables.

qualifier: type II sodium-phosphate cotransporters and Klotho-FGFR
name: Phosphate homeostasis via type II sodium-phosphate cotransporters
rationale: Members concern Pi transport by SLC34 Na+/Pi cotransporters and their disorders, regulated by PTH and FGFR1c-Klotho, distinguishing it from tissue mineralization, dental and vitamin D confusables.

qualifier: epithelial assembly, maintenance and E-cadherin turnover
name: Epithelial cadherin adherens junction assembly and maintenance
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly/maintenance and CDH1 trafficking/degradation, distinguishing it from EMT/cadherin-regulation, apical-basal polarity and desmosome/hemidesmosome confusables.

name: Glutamate reuptake and intracellular glutamate homeostasis
rationale: All members concern glutamate uptake by glutamate transporters (astrocytic SLC1A3, SLC17A8 defects) and glutamate homeostasis, unlike the aspartate-transport and GABA/glycine confusables.

qualifier: BRCA1/BARD1 and BRCA2 loss of function
name: Impaired double-strand break response from BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 loss
rationale: Members concern loss-of-function defects of BRCA1, BARD1 and BRCA2 (nuclear translocation, DSS1 binding) that impair the DSB response, distinguishing it from NHEJ, DSB sensing and homologous-recombination-step defect confusables.

name: AKT-FOXO signaling in insulin-like growth factor response
rationale: Members concern AKT inactivation, localization and acetylation control of FOXO transcription together with IGF/peptide-hormone responses, the latter being absent from the mTORC1/p53/NFE2L2 confusables.

name: Neurotrophin signaling through TRK and p75NTR receptors
rationale: Members concern NGF/BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 signaling via TRKA/B/C downstream cascades and p75NTR survival/death signaling, distinguishing it from the semaphorin/netrin/ephrin axon-guidance confusables.

qualifier: E2F transcription, origin licensing and APC/C-mediated exit
name: Cell cycle progression via E2F, origin licensing and APC/C
rationale: Members concern cell cycle phase transitions: RB/E2F G1/S transcription, pre-replicative complex assembly, G2/M checkpoints and APC/C-driven mitotic exit, lacking the spindle, cohesion, cytokinesis and meiosis machinery of the largest confusable and extending well beyond the p53/DNA-damage confusables.

name: Cationic and neutral amino acid and peptide transport
rationale: Members concern transmembrane transport of neutral amino acids, di/oligopeptides and, distinctively, cationic amino acids (arginine, lysine, ornithine via SLC7A7/SLC25A15), which the proline/glycine, polyamine/inositol and renal SLC confusables lack.

name: Urea cycle and inherited urea cycle enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Members concern urea cycle reactions (citrulline, arginine, ornithine metabolism) and the NAGS/CPS1/OTC/ASS1/ASL/ARG1 deficiencies, distinguishing it from glutamate/proline nitrogen metabolism and arginine catabolism/transport confusables.

qualifier: angiotensin generation and vasoactive peptide catabolism
name: Renin-angiotensin blood pressure control and angiotensin peptide processing
rationale: Members concern renin-angiotensin regulation of blood volume, renal sodium excretion and arterial pressure, plus angiotensinogen-to-angiotensin conversion and bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism that the aldosterone, natriuretic and vasopressin confusables lack.

name: Rho-family GTPase cycles and actin-nucleating effector activation
rationale: Members are the RHO/RAC/CDC42 GTPase cycles and their effectors (WASP/WAVE, formins, IQGAPs) driving Arp2/3 nucleation and lamellipodia, distinguishing it from the RND3, actin-filament dynamics and macropinocytosis confusables.

core: Nuclear RNA processing and exosome decay
qualifier: tRNA processing and small RNA biogenesis
name: Exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay and tRNA/small RNA processing
rationale: Members concern 3'-5' exonucleolytic trimming and surveillance of nuclear RNAs (rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, CUTs, mRNA) together with tRNA end processing/splicing and siRNA/tRF biogenesis, the last two being absent from the rRNA modification, splicing and Pol I/III transcription confusables.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport and membrane cargo targeting
name: Intraflagellar transport and ciliary membrane cargo targeting
rationale: Members concern IFT and BBSome/ARL13B/VxPx-mediated targeting of cargo and receptors into cilia, distinguishing it from cilium assembly/disassembly, motile-cilium axoneme and photoreceptor outer segment confusables.

qualifier: chemotaxis, respiratory burst and degranulation control
name: Neutrophil chemotaxis, respiratory burst and degranulation control
rationale: Members concern regulation of neutrophil recruitment (formyl peptide receptors, granulocyte chemotaxis), superoxide/respiratory burst and degranulation, distinguishing it from microbial killing, Fc-receptor, chemokine-production and extravasation confusables.
